profile_text.body:
Super Micro Computer, Inc. is a public company headquartered in San Jose, California, trading under the ticker SMCI. On its website the company describes itself as a provider of advanced Server Building Block Solutions for markets including 5G/Edge, Data Center, Cloud, Enterprise, Big Data, HPC and Embedded, and says it operates worldwide.

Its site highlights AI systems built around multi-GPU and interconnect technologies, along with GPU servers for data centers, and short-depth and small form factor systems intended to bring compute, AI, and connectivity performance to the edge of the network.

The company's recorded exposure includes 281 cases in California. No lawsuits, products, or MCP servers are listed in the available records.
